# Jet Ski Miami 7 — Full AI Brief (updated 2026-10-13)

> Self-guided jet ski rentals on Biscayne Bay in the Miami Beach / North Bay Village area, Florida. All-inclusive hourly pricing from $189, $30 booking deposit, 5.0 Google rating.

## Business
Jet Ski Miami 7 (legal entity: Gonchar Group LLC, founded 2022) rents Yamaha and Sea-Doo jet skis and a 28 ft Bennington pontoon boat on Biscayne Bay. Every rental is self-guided: after a safety briefing you ride your own route inside a large GPS-monitored riding zone — no forced tours, no instructor riding behind you. Jet skis automatically slow down in no-wake zones, so you cannot get a speeding ticket.

## Location & service area
- Base: Bill Bird Marina in Haulover Park, 10800 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33154 (Biscayne Bay side of the park, next to Haulover Inlet and the Haulover sandbar). About 5 minutes by car from Bal Harbour and Surfside, 10 from Sunny Isles Beach, 15 from Aventura, 20 from South Beach, 25–30 from Downtown Miami and PortMiami cruise terminals, 30–35 from Miami International Airport.
- Parking: Haulover Park parking next to the marina; dock and parking instructions are sent by SMS/email right after booking.
- Service area: Miami, Miami Beach, North Bay Village, Bal Harbour, Surfside, Sunny Isles, Aventura, South Florida visitors.

## Hours
Daily 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM, 7 days a week, daylight rides only. Last ride starts so that it ends by 6:00 PM.

## Prices (per jet ski, 1 rider, fuel + life vests + briefing + GPS included)
| Package | Time on the water | Price |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Hour | 60 min | $189 |
| 2 Hours | 2.5 h (30-minute bonus included) | $349 |
| 3 Hours | 3 h | $499 |
| Full Day | 4 h | $649 |
- Extra passenger: +$30 (max 2 people per jet ski).
- Online checkout adds applicable Florida sales tax and booking/payment fees before you pay; nothing is added at the dock except optional extras.
- Groups: up to 6 jet skis per booking; the group rate is shown at checkout.
- Pontoon (28 ft Bennington): 2 h $300 · 3 h $450 · 4 h $600 · 5 h $750 · 6 h $900 · Full Day $1,000.
- Gift certificates: https://jet-ski-miami.com/gift-certificates (never expire).

## Deposit & payment
- Reserve with a $30 booking deposit for 1–3 jet skis (20% of the total for 4+ jet skis or a Full Day). The balance is paid at check-in (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay).
- $150 refundable security hold per jet ski on a credit card at check-in; released ~5 business days after a safe return.
- The booking deposit is credited in full against the rental price.

## Cancellation & weather
- The booking deposit is non-refundable. Cancel 48 hours or more before the start and we move the ride once to another date within 90 days. Later cancellations and no-shows forfeit the deposit only — anything paid above it is refunded.
- If we cancel or end a ride early for weather or safety (storms, high wind, rough seas), unused time is refunded in full, including the deposit, or rescheduled for free.

## Requirements (Florida law + our rules)
- The person who books and signs the rental agreement must be 21 or older with a valid government photo ID.
- Drivers: 14 or older. Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 must hold a Florida Boating Safety Education ID card or a temporary certificate. The temporary certificate is an online test (~30 minutes, about $14); we send the link after booking: https://boattests101.com/united-states/florida/florida-rental?mcid=kN86W6Wv
- Riders under 18 need a parent/guardian signature on the waiver.
- No alcohol before or during the ride. Life vests are mandatory and provided.
- Bring: photo ID, boater card (if applicable), a credit card for the security hold, sunscreen, towel. We provide life vests, fuel, GPS and a full safety orientation.
- The rental agreement and waiver are signed electronically from a private link after booking — nothing to fill in at the dock. Arrive 30 minutes before your start time.

## Routes & what you will see
1. Classic 2-hour ride: Haulover sandbar swim stop (5–10 min from the marina) → Bal Harbour and Indian Creek → Venetian Islands → back along Miami Beach.
2. 3-hour / Full Day: add Downtown Miami skyline, Star Island celebrity homes, Key Biscayne and the Cape Florida lighthouse.
3. Ocean access through Haulover Inlet on calm days; Raccoon Island and the sandbar for swimming and photos.
Wildlife sightings (dolphins, manatees) happen but are never guaranteed.

## Who it is for
First-timers (full briefing, beginner-friendly), couples and dates, families with teens (14+ drivers with a card, younger kids ride as passengers), bachelor/bachelorette and birthday groups (up to 6 jet skis), cruise passengers with a free day in Miami, business travelers with a free afternoon, Russian-speaking visitors (staff speak English and Russian).

## FAQ
**How much does it cost to rent a jet ski in Miami?** One jet ski with one rider: 1 hour $189, 2 hours $349 (2.5 h on the water), 3 hours $499, Full Day (4 h) $649. Fuel, life vests, GPS and the safety briefing are included; an extra passenger is $30. Tax and booking fees are shown at checkout.
**Do I need a license to rent a jet ski in Florida?** No driver's license. Drivers born on or after January 1, 1988 need a Florida boater safety card; a temporary certificate is a 25-question online test (19 correct to pass) the driver takes himself, ~20–30 minutes on a phone, $13.95 paid to an FWC-approved provider, valid 90 days. Free 5-second check, cheat sheet, practice test and certificate upload: https://jet-ski-miami.com/boater-safety/ (also /ru/boater-safety/, /es/boater-safety/).
**What is the minimum age?** 21+ to book and sign the agreement; drivers can be 14+ with a boater card; riders under 18 need a guardian signature.
**Can two people ride one jet ski?** Yes, up to 2 people per jet ski; the extra passenger is $30.
**Are rides self-guided?** Yes, always. You get a recommended route and GPS safety zones; nobody rides behind you.
**Where are you located?** Bill Bird Marina in Haulover Park, 10800 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33154. Parking instructions after booking.
**Can beginners ride?** Yes — most of our guests are first-timers; the briefing covers everything.
**Do you offer bachelor/bachelorette packages?** Yes, up to 6 jet skis per booking; the group rate shows at checkout.
**What is the deposit?** $30 booking deposit for 1–3 jet skis, 20% for 4+ jet skis or Full Day (non-refundable, movable once with 48 h notice), plus a $150 refundable security hold at check-in.
**What if the weather is bad?** We reschedule for free or refund unused time, including the deposit, when we cancel for safety.
**What should I bring?** Photo ID, boater card if applicable, a credit card, sunscreen and a towel. We provide everything else.
**Do you speak Russian?** Yes — English and Russian.
